brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: Seed-starting tray of at least four cells
requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases at (0,0), (-1,0), (1,0), (0,1), level 0, joined and locked with joint bolts; check_build is clean with meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: Four hex-bin-full-drain bins at (0,0), (-1,0), (1,0), (0,1), one per cell.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell seed-starting tray: four full hex bases in a cluster, each cell holding a full-depth drained bin, with open faces capped and joints bolted. check_build reports no issues and meshClash is clear. No soil, plants or props were added since the brief did not ask for them. Note: the configurator cannot verify material suitability for wet use; the drain holes are the only drainage feature shown.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
